title: Copilot reflection and telemetry - pilot
description: Derived assessments and collection status. Synthetic smoke rows are labelled; real client collection and token accounting are not enabled yet.

options.content:
### Synthetic smoke pilot
Assessment rows labelled `synthetic_azure_model_smoke` are test fixtures, not real project work. Model inference and synthetic native OTLP ingestion are connected; real-client collection and daily scheduling are **not enabled**. Only reviewed derived summaries are published. Project IDs will use `personal/project` or `msft/project`; `synthetic/demo` is reserved for smoke tests. The time picker filters **assessment creation time** for assessments and span start time for telemetry.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Outcome, Summary, Origin, Limitations, SessionEndedAt
| order by TimeGenerated desc

CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastAssessment=max(TimeGenerated), EligibleRowsVisible=count() by ProjectId, Origin
| extend MinutesSinceAssessment=datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastAssessment)
| order by LastAssessment desc

panels.title: Usage and reliability - not collecting yet

options.content:
Real-client collection: **not enabled**. A native macOS collector installer and synthetic OTLP connection check are available.

Real project-level tokens, latency, errors, and delivery health are **unavailable**, not zero. They require a controlled client sample proving workspace identity and the correct accounting layer.

The model test's inference tokens are excluded. The connection-check panel below contains deliberately authored synthetic counts, not real coding usage. Neither assessment nor trace freshness proves the collector is currently healthy. This text is a rollout boundary, not a live process-status signal.

panels.title: Synthetic OTLP connection check - not real usage

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'synthetic_collector_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastTrace=max(TimeGenerated), Spans=count(), InputTokens=sum(tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])), OutputTokens=sum(tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])), CacheReadTokens=sum(tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])) by ProjectId
| extend Status='Synthetic connection check; not coding usage'
| order by LastTrace desc
